title: [7c934759] deploy/prometheus-rules.yaml
content:
# prometheus-rules.yaml
groups:
- name: plaza-ab-testing
  rules:
  - alert: FalseUpgradeRateExceeded
    expr: plaza_false_upgrade_rate > 0.05
    for: 1m
    annotations:
      summary: "误升级率超过5%阈值"
      action: "自动回滚至Blue环境"

  - alert: ResourceIncreaseExceeded
    expr: plaza_resource_increase_pct > 20
    for: 1m
    annotations:
      summary: "资源增幅超过20%阈值"
      action: "自动回滚至Blue环境"

  - alert: ColdStartLatencyHigh
    expr: plaza_policy_eval_latency_ms{quantile="0.99"} > 1000
    for: 30s
    annotations:
      summary: "冷启动耗时超过1秒"
      action: "检查预热缓存机制"
